from common import *
import signal

if __name__=='__main__':
    save_source(__file__)
    progress=read(PROGRESS)
    assert len(progress['jobs'])==5 and all(j['status']=='succeeded' and j['variant']=='quantile7' for j in progress['jobs'])
    assert progress['scientific_candidates']['quantile7']['status']=='trained_awaiting_evaluation'
    oldpid=read(BASE/'docs/user-steering-20261107.json')['coordinator_pid']
    cmd=subprocess.check_output(['ps','-p',str(oldpid),'-o','command='],text=True).strip()
    assert str(TMP/'pipeline_v2.py') in cmd
    os.kill(oldpid,signal.SIGTERM);os.kill(oldpid,signal.SIGCONT)
    prepared=read(BASE/'configs/prepared-inputs.json')
    assert prepared['variants']['quantile7']['encoded_changes']==0
    targets={v:('new' if v=='quantile7' else 'old') for v in VARIANTS}
    amendment={'at':time.time(),'user_instruction':'n的实验在一份样本上做就行了，在效果比较好的样本上，不用两份都做。','selected_label_source':'old','selection_basis':'Existing continuous H20/patience50 control old net_ann31.31% versus new29.49%; source selected before any new n evaluation.','original_contract':fingerprint(BASE/'configs/harness-plan.json'),'original_study':fingerprint(BASE/'configs/frozen-study.json'),'preserved_deadline':read(STATE)['deadline'],'preserved_prior_fit_cost':PRIOR_FITS,'already_started_fits':5,'nominal_total_fits':30,'remaining_nominal_fits':25,'run_priority':VARIANTS,'job_treatments':targets,'equivalence_reuse':{'quantile7':'Five already trained new-labelled jobs reused because prepared old/new float32 targets are exactly identical, with unchanged affine transform; no independent replicate claimed.'},'cancelled_branches':{v:('old redundant duplicate' if v=='quantile7' else 'new counterpart cancelled by user') for v in VARIANTS},'scope':'Only suppress duplicate source branches and use pre-existing old-label treatment as the primary comparison. Six frozen n, features, actual target arrays, affine encodings, seeds, model/early-stop/evaluation protocol and original wallclock remain unchanged. No new scientific candidate or budget reset.','formal_harness_scope':'Original native budget remains an upper bound; exact reduced job schedule is append-only supplementary amendment, linked by native note. Future fits must match job_treatments.','comparison':'All new n compare to old continuous H20 and prior n5/n10 old-label results; new-label results are historical provenance only.'}
    path=BASE/'configs/single-source-amendment.json';assert not path.exists();write(path,amendment)
    progress['expected_fits']=30;progress['source_amendment']=fingerprint(path);progress['status']='prepared_single_source_continuation';progress['pipeline_stage']='single_source_handoff';write(PROGRESS,progress)
    harness('event',{'type':'note','text':'User explicitly reduced n study to one better-performing sample. Use pre-existing old-label targets for all remaining n; quantile7 completed five fits reused by exact old/new target identity. Reduced30-fit schedule and cancelled source branches: '+str(path.relative_to(ROOT))+' SHA256 '+fingerprint(path)['sha256']+'. Original frozen contract, deadline and accrued fit costs retained, no new candidate or budget reset.'})
    # Stop only the old count-display monitor. The resource sampler remains active.
    rows=subprocess.check_output(['ps','-axo','pid=,command='],text=True).splitlines()
    for line in rows:
        fields=line.strip().split(None,1)
        if len(fields)==2 and fields[1].endswith(str(TMP/'monitor.py')):
            os.kill(int(fields[0]),signal.SIGTERM)
    print('Single-source amendment recorded; old coordinator terminated after complete n7 group. 25 further fits planned.',flush=True)
